title: Recursive NAND seed distribution
statement: Define a probability distribution on seeds recursively: at depth $0$ it is concentrated on the unique seed. At depth $d+1$, choose the order uniformly from $\{0,1\}$, choose two depth-$d$ seeds independently according to the depth-$d$ seed distribution, and combine them with that order.
